title: Caleb Ulku Launches AI SEO Mastery Community for Business Owners Seeking Local Search Success
text:
Innovative online community teaches entrepreneurs how to leverage AI tools to improve local search rankings, attract more clients, and scale their businesses affordably.
(PRUnderground) March 12th, 2025
Digital marketing expert Caleb Ulku today announced the launch of AI SEO Mastery, a comprehensive online community designed to help small business owners and independent marketers harness the power of artificial intelligence to improve their search engine rankings and grow their businesses.
With an accessible entry point of just $7 per month, members receive foundational SEO training and community support, with premium content upgrades available for those seeking more advanced strategies. The base subscription includes essential courses covering Modern SEO fundamentals, AI integration basics, and local search optimization techniques. Members also gain access to monthly live Zoom sessions with Caleb, providing personalized guidance and the latest industry insights.
“Small business owners and independent marketers are often overwhelmed by rapid technological changes while trying to balance multiple roles in their businesses,” said Caleb Ulku, founder of AI SEO Mastery. “Our community offers practical, step-by-step guidance that helps them achieve measurable SEO results without requiring extensive technical knowledge or huge marketing budgets.”
The AI SEO Mastery curriculum is specifically designed for time-pressed entrepreneurs who need actionable strategies they can implement immediately. The four-module introductory course takes members from SEO fundamentals to implementation in just 30 days, with a focus on leveraging AI tools to dramatically accelerate results.
Community members particularly benefit from:
Step-by-step implementation guides and templates Real-world case studies from similar-sized businesses Proven systems for small-scale operations Time-saving AI workflows and automation techniques Strategies to compete effectively in local markets “What sets our approach apart is the combination of cutting-edge AI techniques with proven SEO fundamentals,” Ulku added. “We’re not just teaching theory – we’re providing complete systems that work for businesses with limited resources and helping them establish themselves as the go-to experts in their local markets.”
For members seeking more advanced training, premium upgrades provide access to specialized courses including AI SEO Mastery, Upwork success strategies, Facebook Ads for local businesses, and advanced Google Business Profile optimization techniques.
The AI SEO Mastery community is now open for enrollment. For more information or to join, visit https://www.skool.com/ai-seo-mastery/about
About Caleb Ulku
Caleb Ulku is a leading SEO expert and digital marketing educator specializing in AI-powered search engine optimization strategies for small business owners and independent digital marketers. As the founder of the AI SEO Mastery community, Caleb has developed a comprehensive educational ecosystem that helps entrepreneurs transform their digital marketing capabilities through practical, results-driven methodologies.
